scientific_integrity: The rank transfer is proved from finite-field symplectic subspace counts. Exhaustive finite-field tests are corroboration, not proofs for all sizes. Classical matrix-rank enumeration and orbit-method ingredients are attributed to prior literature; no independent novelty certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-field labeled edge-weight enumeration; independent-set joins only, not arbitrary edge additions. The character-degree consequence uses odd characteristic. Historically possible coverage by a broader structured alternating-matrix theorem remains an unresolved residual priority risk; no independent assessment performed.
title: An exact independent-join rank transfer for graphical Lie algebras
